subject: the toy relabelling experiment: both-shapes pictures also captioned with each single caption, and whether the product of the two single captions then draws both shapes
kind: our own experiment (code in subproject 3, no paper)
purpose: the learner will be questioned on it: data setup, the network, training, how it relates to Du et al. 2023, the sampling procedure, and what '0 of 300' and '300 of 300' count

numbers.rule: every value on every rung is read from the JSON; a later rung extends the script and every value already in the JSON must come out unchanged

style.all levels: journey 13's choice, confirmed 2026-11-18: cheat-sheet devices (thin outlines, glow on the part in focus and fade elsewhere, step strips, boxed formulas in real TeX, white space) in this ladder's colour key

notation: plain notation on every rung (z_t the noisy latent at step t, z0_hat the denoiser's guess of the clean latent, e the noise estimate, g the guidance strength, eta the corrector step); Du et al.'s symbols appear only on the Du et al. rung and the closing page, mapped
